node_capability.description: What a provisioned node must provide — CPU cores, memory, and an optional GPU (type + throughput). Mirrors node_capability.schema.json.

cores.description: Logical CPU cores the node provides.

gpu.description: The node's accelerator. Optional; absent means CPU-only (equivalent to kind 'none').

kind.description: The accelerator family. Append-only enum (the lowercase name is the stored identifier).

throughput_tflops.description: Coarse throughput in teraFLOPS. 0 when there is no GPU.

description: How the autoscaler control loop (ADR-29 / ARC-11, #371) is tuned: the per-node capability floor for provisioned nodes, the hysteresis confirmation window, and whether a cost-cap breach sheds immediately. The loop observes a running ComputeJob's progress, scores it with the job's ScalingPolicy, and adds/removes nodes through the Provisioner seam within the policy bounds. Mirrored by zetta::AutoscalerConfig in include/zetta/job_autoscaler.hpp and enforced by AutoscalerConfig::from_json() in src/core/job_autoscaler.cpp — keep them in sync. Omitted fields take their defaults; a malformed config is rejected at the boundary so the loop never silently changes how it behaves.

confirm_ticks.description: Hysteresis: how many consecutive ticks must recommend the same direction before the loop acts. The anti-thrash guard. Must be >= 1 (1 disables the multi-tick confirmation). Defaults to 2.

node_spec.description: The per-node capability floor each provisioned node must meet (passed in the ProvisionRequest on a scale-up). A default (no-floor) capability is satisfied by every node. See node_capability.schema.json.

shed_on_cost_breach.description: When the policy reports the cost cap breached, shed immediately — bypass confirm_ticks. The cost cap is a hard safety constraint. Defaults to true.
